# Datasets description for the construction of the consensus single-cell transcriptomic atlas

@tbl-sc-atlases summarises published single-cell and spatial transcriptomic
atlases relevant to gastrulation, organoid, and related developmental models,
including public dataset access and code repositories where available.

| Title | Author | DOI | Technology | Tissue | Journal | Species | Date | Dataset ID | Dataset Access | GitHub access | Comments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A single-cell molecular map of mouse gastrulation and early organogenesis | Pijuan-Sala, B.; Marioni, J.C. | [10.1038/s41586-019-0933-9](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-019-0933-9) | scRNA-seq (10x Chromium; Smart-seq2 endothelial subset) | Whole embryo (E6.5–E8.5 gastrulation and early organogenesis) | Nature | Mouse | 2019 | E-MTAB-6967 (atlas); E-MTAB-6970, E-MTAB-7324/7325 (chimera subsets); GSE87038 (myeloid annotation support only) | [ArrayExpress E-MTAB-6967](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/arrayexpress/studies/E-MTAB-6967); [Bioconductor MouseGastrulationData](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/data/experiment/html/MouseGastrulationData.html); [Marioni Lab browser](https://marionilab.cruk.cam.ac.uk/MouseGastrulation2018/) | [EmbryoTimecourse2018](https://github.com/MarioniLab/EmbryoTimecourse2018) | Tests how pluripotent epiblast cells diversify into all major embryonic lineages during gastrulation. Builds an *in vivo* molecular roadmap (~116k cells, nine time points) of differentiation trajectories (including visceral vs primitive-streak endoderm convergence) and uses *Tal1*−/− chimaeras to link gene function to early mesoderm diversification; baseline for mutant interpretation and optimisation of *in vitro* protocols. |
| An integrated transcriptomic cell atlas of human endoderm-derived organoids | Xu, Q.; Camp, J.G. | [10.1038/s41588-025-02182-6](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-025-02182-6) | Integrated scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq (10x, Smart-seq, CEL-seq, Sort-seq) | Endoderm-derived organoids (lung, intestine, liver, biliary, stomach, pancreas, prostate, salivary gland) | Nature Genetics | Human | 2025 | HEOCA (CELLxGENE collection); GSE287233 (new intestine/stomach/liver organoid scRNA-seq) | [CELLxGENE HEOCA](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/collections/b4d13dc2-9b75-401d-9d9a-6d1468c17d90); [CAP](https://celltype.info/project/604); [Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8181495](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8181495); [GEO GSE287233](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE287233) | [HEOCA](https://github.com/devsystemslab/HEOCA); [snapseed](https://github.com/devsystemslab/snapseed); [sc2heoca](https://github.com/devsystemslab/sc2heoca) | Tests whether endoderm organoid protocols faithfully recapitulate primary fetal/adult endodermal cell states across organs and stem-cell sources. Constructs HEOCA (~1M cells, 218 samples, 54 datasets) to harmonise annotations, quantify on-/off-target fidelity, map new protocols, and use the atlas as a control cohort for perturbation and disease organoids (e.g. inflammation, CRC, COPD). |
| An integrated transcriptomic cell atlas of human neural organoids | He, Z.; Treutlein, B. | [10.1038/s41586-024-08172-8](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-08172-8) | Integrated scRNA-seq (multi-protocol meta-atlas) | Neural / brain organoids (guided and unguided protocols) | Nature | Human | 2024 | HNOCA (CELLxGENE / Zenodo) | [CELLxGENE HNOCA](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/collections/de379e5f-52d0-498c-9801-0f850823c847); [Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.11203684](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11203684); [ArchMap](https://www.archmap.bio/) | [HNOCA-tools](https://github.com/devsystemslab/HNOCA-tools); [neural_organoid_atlas](https://github.com/theislab/neural_organoid_atlas) | Tests which human brain regions and cell states existing neural-organoid protocols cover, and how closely they match developing primary brain references. Builds HNOCA (>1.7M cells; 36 datasets; 26 protocols) to quantify protocol fidelity/variation, annotate new datasets, and compare disease organoid models against a diverse healthy control atlas. |
| Application of spatial transcriptomics across organoids: a high-resolution spatial whole-transcriptome benchmarking dataset | Nucera, M.R.; Ramialison, M. | [10.1016/j.isci.2026.115827](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2026.115827) | Stereo-seq (sequencing-based spatial whole-transcriptome; multi-organoid on-chip) | Multi-organoid (brain, heart muscle/valve, kidney, lung, cartilage, haematopoietic) plus mouse reference tissues | iScience | Human organoids; mouse references | 2026 | GSE294759 | [GEO GSE294759](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE294759); [bioRxiv preprint](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.05.04.651803) | [StereoseqOrganoids](https://github.com/Ramialison-Lab/StereoseqOrganoids) | Tests whether Stereo-seq can recover spatially organised, transcriptome-wide gene programmes across diverse stem-cell organoids at a resolution and capture depth comparable to *in vivo* tissues. Provides a cross-organoid spatial benchmarking resource (multi-sample chip optimisation, capture-efficiency limits vs reference tissues) and a region-based analysis framework (core vs border) when standard cell-type clustering is underpowered. |
| Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveal somitogenesis in gastruloids | van den Brink, S.C.; van Oudenaarden, A. | [10.1038/s41586-020-2024-3](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2024-3) | scRNA-seq + tomo-seq (genome-wide A–P spatial RNA-seq) + live imaging | Mouse gastruloids (and E8.5 embryo comparison); Matrigel-embedded somite-forming gastruloids | Nature | Mouse | 2020 | GSE123187 | [GEO GSE123187](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE123187); [avo lab browser](https://avolab.hubrecht.eu/MouseGastruloids2020) | [scRNA-seq/tomo-seq analysis](https://github.com/anna-alemany/mouseGastruloids_scRNAseq_tomoseq); [MouseGastruloids](https://github.com/vincentvbatenburg/MouseGastruloids) | Tests whether gastruloids recapitulate embryo-like cell types and spatially organised somitogenesis programmes genome-wide (beyond marker imaging). Builds a gastruloid–embryo scRNA-seq and tomo-seq atlas of A–P gene expression, shows somitogenesis-clock activity *in vitro*, links reduced FGF signalling to short-tail phenotypes, and shows Matrigel embedding induces sequentially forming, correctly patterned somites. |
